definitions.explanation: The actual weight or amount excluding packaging or other additions.
The real or essential content, excluding extras.

examples.japanese: {正味|しょうみ}500グラムの{小麦粉|こむぎこ}を{使|つか}う。
{正味|しょうみ}{何|なん}{時間|じかん}かかりましたか。
examples.english: How many hours did it actually take?
examples.notes: Asking about real working time, excluding breaks

examples.japanese: {正味|しょうみ}の{話|はなし}、{彼|かれ}は{信用|しんよう}できない。
examples.english: To be honest, I can't trust him.
examples.notes: Colloquial: 正味の話 = honestly speaking (Kansai dialect origin)

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{正味|しょうみ}〜グラム (net ~ grams)
・{正味|しょうみ}{重量|じゅうりょう} (net weight)
・{正味|しょうみ}{時間|じかん} (actual time)
・{正味|しょうみ}の{話|はなし} (to be honest - colloquial)

OPPOSITE:
・{総|そう} (gross, total)
・{見|み}かけ (appearance, seeming)

REGIONAL NOTE:
{正味|しょうみ}の{話|はなし} is particularly common in Kansai dialect as a conversational filler meaning "honestly" or "to be real."

[Register: Neutral to Informal]
